valueArray.passage: 大运看十年之祸福，流年看一年之吉凶。运年并论，方得其真。
valueArray.translation: Major cycles reveal fortune and misfortune over ten-year periods; annual cycles reveal luck for a single year. Only by examining both together can the truth be found.
valueArray.source: 渊海子平 · 论大运流年
valueArray.sourceEnglish: Yuanhai Ziping · On Luck & Annual Pillars

valueArray.passage: 太岁者，一年之主宰也。犯太岁则灾，合太岁则吉。
valueArray.translation: Tai Sui is the sovereign of the year. Offending Tai Sui brings disaster; harmonizing with Tai Sui brings fortune.
valueArray.sourceEnglish: Three Lives Compendium · On the Grand Duke (Year God)

valueArray.translation: Shen-Zi-Chen form a Water frame, Hai-Mao-Wei form a Wood frame, Yin-Wu-Xu form a Fire frame, Si-You-Chou form a Metal frame.

valueArray.passage: 辛金软弱，温润而清。畏土之叠，乐水之盈。
valueArray.translation: Xin Metal is soft and delicate — warm, refined, and pure. It fears excessive Earth piling up, and delights in abundant Water.
